name: infostyle
description: Russian text editing in информационный стиль (Ilyahov, Sarycheva). Ships **infostyle** — a full edit pass over prose that starts from context, audience and the reader's useful action, then works structure, paragraph, sentence, word and presentation, with a stop-word catalogue (вводные, неопределённое, заумь, оценки, штампы), bureaucratese repairs, genre checklists (текст о себе, о компании, отчёты, пресс-релиз, слайды, промостраница) and a hard ban on inventing the facts that replace value judgements — and **infostyle-letter** — business correspondence on respect and care instead of ritual politeness: informative subject lines, substance in the first paragraph, boundaries, the do-not-send-on-emotion check, cold emails, complaints, pars, reminders and job replies. Three modes: rewrite, review-only, or re-layout without touching a single word
